title: Shan Reader Grade 2 (ပပ်ႉလူႁဵၼ်း မၢႆ 2)
author: Tai Literature and Culture Association
description: Second-grade reading textbook published by the Tai Literature and Culture Association, advancing students from simple syllables to consonant clusters, diphthongs, tone inflections, traditional stories, animal fables, and community festivals matching Southwestern Tai oral narrative structures.

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ လူႁဵၼ်း မၢႆ သွင် ပုၼ်ႈတႃႇ လုၵ်ႈႁဵၼ်း ၸၼ်ႉ သွင်
sentences.text_roman: pap lu hen mai sawng pun ta luk hen can sawng
sentences.assamese_script: পাপ লু-হেন মাই ছঙ পুন তা লুক-হেন চান ছঙ
sentences.free_translation_en: Reading study book number two for second-grade students.
sentences.free_translation_as: দ্বিতীয় শ্ৰেণীৰ শিক্ষার্থীসকলৰ বাবে টাই ভাষাৰ দ্বিতীয় ভাগ পাঠ্যপুথি।
sentences.speaker: Tai Educational Editor

sentences.text_roman: khun nu tük pe tu mew nai pung

sentences.speaker: Tai Storyteller

sentences.text_roman: wo thik thai na khao mai le khao phun

sentences.notes: Bathing of Buddha statues during Poy Sangken.
